About the Social Fun Sunday group ride

The Charleston club's easy Sunday ride. Twenty-two flat miles around Sullivan's Island and Mount Pleasant at 14 to 18 mph, no-drop. All Coastal Cyclists rides are open to non-members who want to try the club.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
